name: Multilingual v2
description: Advanced text-to-speech model with natural, expressive voices.
longDescription: ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 is a state-of-the-art text-to-speech model capable of generating natural, emotionally expressive speech across 29 languages. It supports voice cloning, custom voice design, and real-time streaming.

codeSnippets.code:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM",
    headers={"xi-api-key": "$ELEVENLABS_API_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json={"text": "Hello world!", "model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2"}
)
with open("output.mp3", "wb") as f:
    f.write(response.content)
